profile.headline: Consciousness plumber at Elicit
profile.summary: Motivated programmer with experience working both independently and in a team environment. Practical knowledge of development on both simple and complex web applications. Versatile, reliable, and able to learn new skills on the fly. Looking for organizations with challenging and competitive environments.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Working in Cloud Infrastructure to help Stripe build out global infrastructure quickly and efficiently.

positions.title: R&D Software Engineer 2
positions.description:
I work developing software that manages the global deployment of the ETMS test platform to ~5000 stations spread across 15 sites. This software is directly involved in the production of thousands of hardware units, and requires an extremely high level of availability.

I developed new deployment infrastructure that cut build/deploy speed in half while providing significantly increased reliability and maintainability. As part of this project I worked in Malaysia for 4 months helping to set up infrastructure and providing training for the users who would be taking advantage of the new systems. This new infrastructure also added support for Nuget and modern package management to developers, helping increase code sharing and reuse across disparate development teams.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
• Designed and Implemented mobile first user interfaces for web applications
• Worked in a team environment to plan and build out a full ecommerce platform
• Maintained vital legacy code, and updated web sites to meet new standards

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
Developed a classification pipeline for analysing brain scans under a National Science Foundation grant
Programmed a a novel software implementation for analysing deformation on fault lines
Wrote research reports for communicating key findings in a professional context

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
I work developing software for use with the ETMS test executive which is used to manage and automate testing and calibration using Keysight's measurement hardware.

My work has high interoperability requirements, and I often deal with legacy systems.

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description: I developed software used by Keysight Technologies to help customers migrate data between installations, developing my knowledge of C#, project management, and desktop application interface design.

positions.title: Freight Crew
positions.description:
Worked to keep store stocked, and to organize new product arrivals.
Aided in digital inventory of store stock. 
Utilized free time to improve customer experience and fix broken equipment.

volunteerExperiences.description: I worked at Mountain Chapel doing sound engineering for a live band for 4-6 hours a week. This required both technical knowledge of the equipment involved, as well as quick learning an adaptability to the wide variety of situations encountered in a live music setting. I eventually worked my way up to managing and coordinating video and audio recordings in a team setting, handling scheduling and communication between a small team. I learned the use of analog mixing board, Logic Pro, Garageband, and a variety of other hardware and software used to run the music services smoothly.

I volunteered at La Tercera's Family Math Night, which involved interacting with both parents and students on a personal level. I helped students to understand and work towards solving various mathematics related challenges provided by The Lawrence Hall of Science, and explained to parents the skills being developed by different challenges.

testScores.name: SAT Reasoning Test
testScores.description: The SAT helps college admission officers make fair and informed admission decisions. Combined with a student's academic record, it is a proven, reliable indicator of college success. Since its launch in 1926, the SAT has helped millions of students connect with college success and today remains the most reliable, effective measure of a student's college readiness. The SAT tests the subject matter learned by students in high school and how well they apply that knowledge—the critical thinking skills necessary to succeed in college.

testScores.name: ACT Assessment Plus Writing
testScores.description:
The ACT consists of four multiple-choice tests: English, mathematics, reading, and science. The ACT with writing includes the four multiple-choice tests and a writing test.
The test measures standard written English and rhetorical skills, mathematical skills students have typically acquired in courses taken up to the beginning of grade 12, reading comprehension, the interpretation, analysis, evaluation, reasoning, and problem-solving skills required in the natural sciences, and the writing skills emphasized in high school English classes and in entry-level college composition courses.
